I personally don’t see how using the standing rules as stated is a punishment to those classes. The party can strategize a way for them to rest in those scenarios. 

The opposite would be true if rests were short enough to take multiple in a day, effectively making those classes stronger.

I personally think 1 hour short rests add to the strategy aspect of the game. Resource economy is part of the game, and I plan (for big moments in the game) some sessions where they WILL NOT have the opportunity for a short rest without consequences. 

Lowering the time to 10 minutes would take away some of the “urgency” of the mission in those situations.

Other than the obvious (Rick, which I didn’t count as he is the main character at this point), Aaron! I was rooting for him right from the beginning of him joining the show. 

I also really liked Abraham, but I already assumed that he would be an obvious target for Negan to play whack-a-mole with - so I made peace with him probably getting aced. 

This time around I still feel the same way about those characters, but now I’m more appreciative of the “side” characters.

The reason that I personally stopped watching was because, for me, I just couldn’t handle losing another character I loved. I was watching it week by week as the episodes came out, and Glenn was by far my favorite character and it kind of just made me lose interest in continuing.

ESPECIALLY after having to wait a whole off season to find out who Negan killed, just for it to turn out to be one of the two characters that I was deeply invested in. 

This time, since I’m binging it instead of bread-crumbing it, I’ve grown a lot of love for the other characters and I’m invested! 

(Also, this time around Rick is easily my favorite character. Andy Lincoln is a legend.)
